steps.title: Discover
steps.desc: Understand the product, users, constraints. Map the scope. Align on what success looks like.

steps.title: Architect
steps.desc: Pick the stack. Design the data model. Sketch the API. Set up CI, infra, and environments.

steps.title: Build & Ship
steps.desc: Iterative delivery in small PRs. Demoable increments every week. Bug-fix in minutes, not days.

steps.title: Operate
steps.desc: Deploy, monitor, measure. Ongoing maintenance, perf tuning, feature additions as needed.
